headline: The never-dry kick raced itself — slot b stopped legally at a full stop
lede: The warden named MINESWEEPER as the weakest stage, slot a filed and claimed it six minutes later, and the live board answered NONE before slot b could reach the claim. Pin (c) from #2910 is the documented disposition: the tick's pick is a hint, the lane's live idle-kick is the decision. The shelf is clean: every unheld title's gaps are owned or closed.

notes.text: Never-dry collided with a parallel slot for the first time on the weak rung — evidence + fix amendment posted on #2910 (kick prompts should be generated from post-assignment state, and pin (c) belongs in idle-kick code, not just a comment thread).

The board at close is honestly dry: flagship stage null, weakest stage null, idle-kick NONE, halt none. When #3026 (best times) merges, Minesweeper opens again — a scoped unowned fidelity gap (press-preview/cancel-release feel) is written into STATE.md for the next kick's why-line.
QA lanes hold Contra (#3018, live); #3008's rules-bug meat is verified dead by QA mini — its residue is the advisory load-flake family (rule-3 rerun territory, not builder work).
